label.what: Assign the state to exactly one of the offered labels. They partition the domain: every state belongs to one of them.
label.not_for: Inventing a label that is not offered, or reading the label from what the caller appears to want, from the order the labels are offered, or from the solver's proposal.
label.evidence: Only what is observable in `state.input`. The label descriptions are the whole definition of each label.
